hints.tr: `any(c.islower() for c in password)` en az bir küçük harf varsa `True`.
hints.en: `any(c.islower() for c in password)` is `True` if there is at least one lower-case letter.

hints.tr: "Öteki" karakterler: `any(not c.isalnum() for c in password)`.
hints.en: "Other" characters: `any(not c.isalnum() for c in password)`.
